newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM rubber ends lower on weaker overseas prices.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM rubber ends lower on weaker overseas prices.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures reversed early gains to end lower on Monday, as early bargain-hunting buying ebbed later on weaker overseas markets, traders said. Activity remained sluggish with no bullish factors in sight.
Rubber prices ranged from 0.9 yen to 1.8 yen per kg lower. The benchmark September contract was off 1.8 yen at 143.2 yen.

The market started the day firmer, backed by the yen's renewed fall. "Interest in rubber futures remains thin as Southeast Asian rubber prices are expected to head south as supplies rise," one analyst at a commodity broker said.
